ground_truth.method: visual montage sampling (every 20 frames over the full window + every frame across the warmup region), strong gamma+CLAHE brightening for the dark IR footage
ground_truth.notes: Single floor dancer, present and standing/walking in every frame of [1500,1800). N=1 constant. The only reported=0 frames are abs 1500-1513 (structural track-confirmation lag: YOLO detects every frame, golden zero_detection_frames=0, but a track needs TRACK_WARMUP_THRESHOLD=15 consecutive matches before it is confirmed/emitted). Excluded by warmup=15. No genuine mid-recording drops; no over-counts (reported never exceeded 1).
